policy: Manually reviewed implementation excerpts for the catalog schemas represented by successful full-auto cases. Inclusive one-based ranges in the pinned upstream snapshot. These retain broader source variants and policy checks and are descriptive source context, not scope-equivalent implementations of the concrete TEPL cases. Union ranges before aggregating to avoid counting shared code repeatedly. General XLA libraries and visitor setup are excluded; selected local helpers are reported separately.

transpose-reshape-transpose-compose.note: Nested-transpose branch; ComposePermutations implementation is outside this snapshot.

broadcast-elementwise.note: Complete broadcast-sinking helper, shared by addition and multiplication cases; also handles other elementwise functions, arbitrary arity and scalar expansion.

broadcast-scalar-through-indexing.note: Shared user-scanning branch for scalar broadcast through permutations/subsets; TEPL cases select reverse and transpose.

reduction-negate.note: Negated sum-reduction branch; source checks floating dtype, zero initializer and additive reducer.

reduction-compose.note: MergeReduces and its eligibility branch, shared by both scoped sum cases; source supports more reducers and axis sets.

reduction-transpose.note: Complete transpose/reduce branch including optional output transpose and policy; TEPL uses a rank-two sum instance.

indexing-reverse-compose.note: Nested-reverse branch and local setup, shared by general and disjoint-axis cases; includes cancellation.

indexing-reverse-elementwise.note: Scalar-broadcast recognizer and binary-elementwise reverse motion, including both operand orders; TEPL selects addition.

indexing-slice-compose.note: General unit-stride composition branch, shared by general, rank-one and zero-start cases.

dot-associate.note: Complete nested-dot reassociation helper, including both directions, generalized axes, cost selection and optional output transpose; TEPL selects ordinary matrix multiplication.

dot-transpose-output.note: Canonical-dot transpose implementation and its operand-swap policy; the alternate noncanonical-dot implementation is excluded. TEPL uses rank-two matrix multiplication.

dot-move-reverse.note: Shared dot-reordering setup, reverse branch and common construction/cost tail; pad and broadcast branches excluded. TEPL uses a rank-one inner product.

broadcast-compose.note: Nested-broadcast branch; TEPL case restricts broadcasts to appended axes.

dot-swap-parameter-operand.note: Complete operand-swap helper, including parameter policy, precision and arbitrary free/batch axis bookkeeping; TEPL uses a rank-two identity without policy screening.

dot-no-contraction.note: Complete no-contraction lowering helper; includes generalized normalization, dtype conversions and graph metadata. TEPL uses same-type rank-one operands.

dot-reduce-product.note: Complete product/reduction lowering helper; includes generalized normalization and accumulation conversion. TEPL uses a same-type rank-one inner product.

dot-reduce-output-batch.note: Batch-to-contraction reduction branch; source also handles remaining batch/free reductions, whereas TEPL reduces the sole batch axis.

elementwise-compare-selected-mask.note: Mask-selection comparison branch; TEPL uses scalar literal branches. Shared compare operand setup is excluded.

elementwise-compare-max.note: GT guard, captures and maximum branch, including both matched operands; TEPL selects one operand order.

elementwise-compare-min.note: Shared GT guard/captures and minimum branch, including both matched operands; TEPL selects one operand order.

broadcast-multiply-constant-into-broadca.note: Constant-factor/broadcast branch, including literal and numerical-policy checks; TEPL treats the scalar factor as a capture.

broadcast-transpose.note: Same-rank broadcast-to-transpose branch; uses the external InversePermutation helper.

broadcast-transpose-broadcast.note: Complete transpose/broadcast helper, including sorted-map and layout policy; TEPL evaluates a general insertion-only algebraic equation.

broadcast-slice-broadcast-only.note: Broadcast-only slicing predicate and replacement branch; TEPL selects a rank-one base mapped to axis zero.

indexing-slice-singleton-stride.note: Complete redundant-stride helper and caller; source changes qualifying axes selectively, while the TEPL case requires singleton output extents throughout.

dot-transpose-both-operands.note: Complete operand-transpose helper, with canonical batch-axis constraints and precision handling; TEPL selects rank-two matrix transposes.

dot-move-broadcast.note: Shared dot-reordering setup, broadcast branch and common construction/cost tail; pad and reverse branches excluded. TEPL selects one broadcast-created contraction axis.

dot-reduce-output-free.note: Complete free-axis reduction/dot helper with mapping and profitability logic; TEPL reduces the left free axis of a rank-two dot.

dot-scalar-multipliers.note: Complete scalar-factor relocation helper with cost-based placement, graph traversal and constant folding; TEPL is one local scalar-factor identity.

reduction-broadcast-original-axes.note: Reduce/broadcast commutation branch with reduction-axis lookup and surviving broadcast-axis renumbering; TEPL is a rank-one-base sum specialization.
